temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits that he has been keeping something from Christian and that he is in some trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Christian's suspicion is confirmed: Jonathan really has been hiding something, and it is trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding that he is in trouble, though the nature of the trouble is still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the truth and get Jonathan to explain what is going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, and admits he could use support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding details from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Christian learns that Jonathan's trouble is complicated and that Jonathan needs help, even though he is reluctant to involve him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in complicated trouble, needs support/resources, and Christian can help him get out of it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support and to help Jonathan figure out a way out of the mess.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure whether the trouble is illegal, that he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but that he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in complicated trouble, needs support/resources, and the exact nature of the trouble is still unclear.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Christian now considers that Jonathan's trouble may be related to criminal activity or the wrong people, though Jonathan denies doing anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be entangled with the wrong people or criminal activity, but he claims personal innocence; Christian needs to investigate carefully.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan and to make sure Jonathan is safe.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed, and he tells Jonathan this.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be involved with the wrong people or criminal activity, and Christian needs to investigate discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Christian's investigation changes his belief: Jonathan is not the guilty party but is being set up by someone.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed and is innocent; someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name and gather more evidence to prove his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian has found out that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed, and Christian is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Christian now identifies the real culprit as someone close to and trusted by both him and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both of them is behind the framing; this is a betrayal by a trusted person.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice, ensuring the betrayal does not go unpunished.
